original_ai_output.title_zh: 西非国家经济共同体议会能否将气候承诺转化为区域行动？
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 西非国家经济共同体（ECOWAS）议会在加纳阿克拉举行2026年第二次特别会议及议会研讨会，主题为气候变化作为环境退化、人口流离失所和日益加剧的不安全感的驱动因素。议会通过决议，敦促ECOWAS领导人考虑设立区域气候韧性与人类安全基金，并将气候韧性纳入国家预算、发展规划、土地利用政策、冲突预防机制和减灾战略。加纳方面表示到2030年需要约226亿美元实施气候行动。议长指出西非缺乏的是落实现有框架所需的资金和政治意愿。

location.site: ECOWAS议会特别会议及研讨会

key_facts.fact: ECOWAS议会在加纳阿克拉举行2026年第二次特别会议及议会研讨会，主题为气候变化与不安全
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: That convergence framed the ECOWAS Parliament’s Second 2026 Extraordinary Session and Second Parliamentary Seminar in Accra, Ghana. It was themed “Climate Change as a Driver of Environmental Degradation, Population Displacement and Growing Insecurity in the ECOWAS Region.”

key_facts.fact: 议会通过决议，敦促ECOWAS领导人考虑设立区域气候韧性与人类安全基金
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Parliament’s adopted resolutions offered one answer, urging ECOWAS leaders to consider establishing a regional fund dedicated to climate resilience and human security.

key_facts.fact: 加纳表示到2030年需要约226亿美元实施气候行动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He disclosed that Ghana would require an estimated 22.6 billion dollars by 2030 to implement its climate actions and strengthen resilience.

key_facts.fact: ECOWAS议会议长称西非缺乏的是落实现有框架所需的资金和政治意愿
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: “What West Africa lacks are the financing and political will required to implement existing frameworks and transform them into visible and tangible assets for citizens,” she said.
